headline: Ghana Sets November 12 for Budget Presentation Amid Deficit Focus
summary: Ghana's Deputy Finance Minister confirmed November 12 as the date for the 2027 Budget presentation, with investors closely watching deficit targets.
why: National budget announcements and deficit targets are critical for monitoring fiscal discipline and debt restructuring progress in developing economies.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Budget plans set fiscal policy direction affecting investor risk perception.
